## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are scoped and upstream provenance/licenses are preserved.
- [ ] No ROMs, tables, helper binaries, credentials, private state or live QR images are included.
- [ ] Shared-runtime changes have relevant offline regression evidence.
- [ ] Runtime changes passed the Windows quality workflow, including native VBS tests.
- [ ] Compatibility/documentation reflects evidence without promoting map eligibility to support.

For documentation-only changes, mark runtime checks not applicable and describe
link/example validation instead. Hardware and service qualification cannot be
inferred from CI. Explain any applicable checklist item left incomplete.
